name: rekal
description: Memory for your agent, built on four ideas. Save the session transcript raw and append-only — no summaries to rot. Agent agnostic: Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini, Copilot, Kiro, OpenCode. Reason at query time over the real record. Git is the transport and embedding is local — no server, no external memory service. Sets up the binary and turns memory on per repository.
